stages.name: Scan/Score/Select or Procedural Unique Candidate
stages.gate: PASS_CANDIDATE only. Procedural fallback may seed the unique boss but is never final by itself.

stages.name: Canonical Rig + Six Animations + PBR
stages.gate: canonical humanoid coverage + weighted body + 6 actions + 4 NARIS PBR materials + reasonable boss height

stages.name: Unreal Import + Physics/LOD/Animation + QA Arena
stages.gate: SkeletalMesh + Skeleton + PhysicsAsset + >=4 material slots + >=3 LODs + Idle/Walk/Attack/Phase2/HitReact/Death + saved QA map

stages.name: Rendered D3D12 Acceptance + Gameplay Replacement + Packaged Boss Regression
stages.gate: rendered boss comparison must pass silhouette/material/deformation/animation/phase2 checks; replacement then requires clean Win64 build, cook/stage/pak/archive, packaged boss/combat regression, and automatic rollback on failure

current_working_policy: Do not replace the existing Ash Warden gameplay proxy until P0-BOSS-04 passes.
